put.description: Legacy endpoint: grant membership (role = the user's global role) to the listed projects; revoke others.

get.description: Members of one project. Non-admin members see names and project roles only (no e-mail, no other projects).

delete.description: Revoke project access. Historical actions (reviews, decisions, audit) are kept (SRS 13.1).

get.description: Sequential workflow monitoring: every stage with actor, role, time, comments, evidence and status.
Completed DOC_03: sections, comments, final disposition and attachment index (read-only for every role).

ZIP: the DOC_03 PDF exactly as issued, every original attachment the user may open, and a manifest (author, stage, time, SHA-256).
Access is checked for every file; files that fail their integrity check are left out and listed as such.

delete.description: Remove an RFI line from a DOC_01 batch that has never been submitted.

post.description: RE/DRE sets the ordered list of inspectors still to review (FR-09, FR-10, SRS 5.4).
Final RE/DRE disposition (FR-16/17/18, BR-07). Admin has no decision authority (DR-01).

get.description: Kept for older clients: same checks as /evidence/files/{id}/download.

delete.description: Kept for older clients: removal before submission by the uploader only (see /evidence/files/{id}).

post.description: Create (or reuse) the caller's DRAFT remark for a stage of an RFI / DOC_01 batch. Drafts are private to their author.

get.description: Submitted remarks the user may see, plus the user's own drafts.

post.description: Record a DOC_01 review remark on its own. Other stages are submitted by their workflow action.

delete.description: Remove a file before submission. Only its uploader may do this, and never after it is locked.

get.description: Attachment index of an RFI: every file the user may see, with author, stage, time and checksum.
Evidence the signed-in user added (inspector 'Attachments' menu).
Read-only audit trail. Admin: all. RE/DRE: their projects only. No update/delete endpoints exist.
RFI status / pending / overdue / decision report for one project (JSON; the register exports give the row detail).
Role-specific dashboard for one project (SRS 12 Usability, brief section 8).

AssignmentPlan.title: AssignmentPlan
AssignmentPlan.description: The ordered list of inspectors still to review (index 0 reviews first).

EvidenceAmendmentCreate.title: EvidenceAmendmentCreate
EvidenceAmendmentCreate.description: Correction of a locked inspector review (target_kind REVIEW, target_id = assignment id) or management remark (REMARK).
